subtasks.title: Scope the admin Bird's-Eye Live Hits Pending Repossession list to the selected/followed driver (frontend wiring)
subtasks.approach: Wire dashboard.fetchRecentHits into the two admin selection mutation points that currently skip it, and broaden buildUrl's follow-priority special-case from stats-only to also cover /dashboard/recent-hits. No backend change (the recentHits endpoint + scopedKits already honor kit_ids and are covered by an existing passing test).
subtasks.intended_diffs: 1) stores/map.js setSelectedKits(ids): add `dashboard.fetchRecentHits(dashboard.range)` into the existing Promise.all (dashboard is already resolved via useDashboardStore() in that fn), so the combobox selection refreshes the pending list instantly instead of on the next ~10s poll. 2) stores/map.js setFollowedDriver(kitId) and clearFollowedDriver(): alongside the existing `useDashboardStore().fetchStats().catch(()=>{})`, add `useDashboardStore().fetchRecentHits(useDashboardStore().range).catch(()=>{})` (capture the store once per fn to avoid double-resolve), so follow/un-follow re-scopes the pending list to the followed driver. 3) lib/fetch.js buildUrl(): change the follow-priority predicate so a followed driver takes priority for BOTH the stats path and the recent-hits path — e.g. `const followScoped = followedKitId.value != null && (path.includes('/dashboard/stats') || path.includes('/dashboard/recent-hits'));` then `const scope = followScoped ? [followedKitId.value] : selectedKitIds.value;`. Keep the heatmap exclusion and array-emit behavior unchanged. 4) composables/useBirdsEyePolling.js: reword the line-27 comment ('fresh org-wide') to reflect that the list stays fresh at whatever scope (selection/follow/org-wide) is currently active. Comment-only; no behavior change.

excluded_sites: app/Http/Controllers/Api/ClarityScoutBirdsEyeController.php recentHits/scopedKits — already correct + tested; no change
ClarityScoutDashboardController@recentHits (driver, single-kit) — separate surface; the driver app never reaches setSelectedKits/setFollowedDriver (admin-only callers)
useKitPositionPolling.js:53 fetchRecentHits — driver poll (liveMode-gated); not modified; buildUrl change only affects the ADMIN_MODE branch
Heatmap layers — intentionally org-wide (address-based, no kit dimension)
notes: Single tightly-coupled node: the setFollowedDriver refresh (edit 2) is only correct WITH the buildUrl broadening (edit 3), so they must ship together — not parallelizable.

No JS test runner exists; the test_filter runs the existing PHP backend test as a regression proof that the kit_ids contract this fix relies on stays green (no backend diff, so it should stay green). Real behavioral verification is Phase 6/7 browser QA.

Frontend change → must `npm run build` and COMMIT built assets (public/build is tracked); reverting build output would drop the feature. `npm run build` also regenerates boost docs (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/.junie/boost.json) — revert those before committing.
Range: pass the dashboard store's current range to fetchRecentHits (mirrors setRange/fetchAll); do NOT hardcode 'today' outside the poll.
